ModMetaData.name: Variety Matters Redux
ModMetaData.author: Evyatar108
ModMetaData.description:
Cooks actually rotate ingredients instead of smashing the same three berries into every meal. Variety Matters Redux hooks the bill solver (BestVariety_AllowMix) so each meal draws from different ingredient stacks, and pawns track what they've eaten across a sliding window to drive a 13-stage variety thought — compared to the 2 mood stages offered by Vanilla Food Variety Expanded.
Pawns gain a Variety need that rises with repetitive meals and falls when their diet genuinely diversifies. Expectations scale by wealth tier, and per-race settings let you tune or disable the need for animals, mechanoids, and modded xenotypes. Under the hood, no per-meal allocations in the cooking hot path, save-compatible scribe layout, and defensive compat with Human Alien Races and Meals Over Preserved Foods.
If you want cooks that diversify ingredients rather than just label meals differently, this is the one.
